q: What should an EU importer ask a Turkish rebar supplier for under CBAM?
title: EU importers: Turkish rebar data
short: Direct embedded emissions per tonne of rebar from the installation, including the crude steel or billet precursor, for the period, with the production route stated. For iron and steel, CBAM counts direct emissions only.
audience: EU importers and declarants buying rebar and long products from Turkish mills

p: Embedded direct emissions per tonne, by product.
Precursor emissions and whether the billet was made on site or bought.
Any carbon price actually paid in Turkey, with evidence.
Scrap-based electric arc furnace steel and blast furnace steel give very different figures, so ask which route each lot came from.
